note: What Vicky does on its own, and what it may never do on its own. Every job writes a run-log line; anything with 'approval': true stops at the approvals queue and waits for a person.

jobs.does: Pull yesterday's Search Console rows for the tracked pages, save one snapshot to state/seo/daily, flag pages that lost clicks or impressions and queries we rank 11-20 for.
Fetch the live sitemap and 8 sample pages; check they return 200, the canonical matches, the title and description are still within limits, and no page shows a price.
Group the week's real Search Console queries that have impressions but no matching page, and propose new landing pages or copy edits.
Draft next week's posts from config/campaign_templates.json using real stock and real offers only; attach photos already in the repo.
List approved campaigns scheduled for today so a person can post them. Vicky never posts to a public account itself.
Check inbox/photos and inbox/catalogues for new client files; prepare a branch that adds them (prices stripped) and open a pull request with the preview link.
Summarise new leads and enquiries from the Sheet into one message for the owner.
Export the Google Sheet tabs to backups/ as CSV and prune records older than the retention window.
Run npm audit and npm run preflight on a fresh clone; report anything that fails.
writes: approvals (kind: website) if a fix is needed

neverAutomatic: Publishing to the live website (a person merges the pull request)
Posting to Google Business Profile, Instagram or WhatsApp
Changing business facts: phone, address, GSTIN, brands, offers
Presenting a supplier or generated photo as Elite Balaji's own work
